newsitem.title: USA: Midland sees 1997 revs exceeding $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Midland sees 1997 revs exceeding $100 mln.

text.p: Midland Inc expects 1997 revenues to exceed $100 million from its shipping and commodities divisions, the company's North American managing director, Charles Stidham, said Monday.
The figure compares with Midland's unaudited 1996 revenues of $21.5 million.
Stidham said the expected increase stems from a newly inaugurated regularly-scheduled cargo run on three of the company's container ships from Piraeus, Greece, to Taganrog, Russia.
Midland said its agricultural division will deliver 25,000 metric tons of sunflower seeds monthly for six months to Organise Sanayi Bolgesi of Manisa, Turkey, under a contract worth $43 million.
It said Doninvest, a Russian commercial bank, will provide funding for its acquisition of land and cold storage facilities at the port of Taganrog. It did not state the amount of the funding.
